name: OceanOne
def: Humanoid diving robot from Stanford with two arms, stereo eyes and thrusters, steered by a pilot who feels what its hands touch through haptic controls.
facts: Recovered a vase from La Lune, a flagship of Louis XIV that sank off Toulon in 1664, on its first mission in 2016
Followed in 2022 by the deeper diving OceanOneK
